title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Johns Hopkins University
description: Ten under-21-safe Johns Hopkins dining destinations with officially posted service at or after 9 p.m., spanning Homewood, Peabody, and the East Baltimore medical campus.

cards.title: The Midnight Market Run
cards.subtitle: Homewood campus convenience stop
cards.notes: Head to Charles Street Market when the dining halls have wound down; its posted schedule reaches midnight every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day Homewood option with the latest posted closing time on the campus dining schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Charles Street Market as open from 9 a.m. to midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official current schedule lists service until midnight every day; check the page for academic-break changes.

cards.title: Late Night at Peabody
cards.subtitle: Peabody Institute dining hall
cards.notes: Use the designated Late Night period for an evening meal, noting that the longest posted service runs Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A formally scheduled Late Night service inside the Peabody Institute.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining posts Peabody Dining Hall Late Night service until 10 p.m. Sunday through Wednesday and until 11 p.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Late Night runs 9–10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 9–11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday on the posted schedule.

cards.title: Connie’s After Ten
cards.subtitle: Bloomberg Student Center
cards.notes: Choose Connie’s for a student-center food run after 10 p.m.; the same closing time is posted across all seven days.
cards.short_summary: The Bloomberg Student Center’s consistently late-closing food counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Connie’s as open until 10:30 p.m. every day, with weekday opening at 10 a.m. and weekend opening at 11:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule currently shows a 10:30 p.m. closing time Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Dinner to Ten
cards.subtitle: Homewood residential dining
cards.notes: Plan this run Sunday through Thursday, when the posted dinner window continues two hours later than on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Homewood dining-hall dinner option extending to 10 p.m. on five nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Hopkins Café dinner until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday, and until 8 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner is posted through 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; Friday and Saturday service ends at 8 p.m.

cards.title: The Nine O’Clock Cutoff
cards.subtitle: Bloomberg Student Center
cards.notes: Arrive before the posted 9 p.m. close for this seven-day student-center option, and verify the schedule during university breaks.
cards.short_summary: An evening food counter with identical posted hours throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Lucky Danger as open from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The current official schedule lists service until 9 p.m. every day of the week.

cards.title: A Weeknight Koshary Run
cards.subtitle: Bloomberg Student Center
cards.notes: Make this a Monday-through-Friday run and order before 9 p.m.; the official schedule lists the counter as closed on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A weekday-only student-center counter serving through the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Koshary as open from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours end at 9 p.m. Monday–Friday; the location is closed Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Mo’s Before Closing
cards.subtitle: Bloomberg Student Center
cards.notes: Use Mo’s Place for a weekday evening stop and arrive ahead of 9 p.m.; Saturday and Sunday are marked closed on the dining page.
cards.short_summary: A five-day evening option in the Bloomberg Student Center lineup.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists Mo’s Place as open from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule posts a 9 p.m. weekday close and no Saturday or Sunday service.

cards.title: Dinner on 33rd
cards.subtitle: Homewood residential dining
cards.notes: Choose a Monday-through-Friday dinner run to use the full posted window; weekend dinner closes one hour earlier.
cards.short_summary: A named Homewood dining hall with weekday dinner service through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopkins Dining lists dinner at Nolan’s on 33rd until 9 p.m. Monday through Friday and until 8 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner currently ends at 9 p.m. Monday–Friday and at 8 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Coffee in the Hospital Arcade
cards.subtitle: Johns Hopkins Hospital campus
cards.notes: Use this medical-campus café for an evening grab-and-go stop; the hospital posts the same 10 p.m. close every day.
cards.short_summary: A daily late café option between the Zayed and Bloomberg buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Johns Hopkins Medicine identifies Arcade Daily Grind Cafe in the arcade between the Zayed and Bloomberg buildings and lists daily hours of 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dining at The Johns Hopkins Hospital | Johns Hopkins Medicine
cards.access_notes: Johns Hopkins Medicine currently posts 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily; hospital visitor access requirements may apply.

cards.title: The Around-the-Clock Sandwich Run
cards.subtitle: Johns Hopkins Hospital campus
cards.notes: Use the Cobblestone Cafe Subway when other counters are closed, while observing any hospital entry and visitor requirements.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour restaurant option on the East Baltimore medical campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Johns Hopkins Medicine lists Subway in Cobblestone Cafe as open 24/7 and serving sandwiches, protein bowls, and related items.
cards.source_title: Dining at The Johns Hopkins Hospital | Johns Hopkins Medicine
cards.access_notes: The restaurant is officially listed as open 24/7; hospital entry or visitor-access procedures may still apply.
